objective.text: The investigation examines the combustion behavior of n-dodecane and mixtures of n-dodecane/iso-dodecane at pressures ranging from 0.25 atm to 5 atm.
objective.quote: Examine the combustion behavior of n-dodecane and mixtures of n-dodecane/iso-dodecane at pressures ranging from 0.25 atm to 5 atm.

fuel.text: Fuels observed include n-dodecane, farnesane, and mixtures of n-dodecane/iso-dodecane.
fuel.quote: Fuels observed include n-dodecane, farnesane, and mixtures of n-dodecane/iso-dodecane.

sample_geometry.text: Droplets of fuel are dispensed and suspended between hypodermic needles or tethered using silicon-carbide fibers.
sample_geometry.quote: Droplets of fuel are dispensed and suspended between hypodermic needles or tethered using silicon-carbide fibers.

pressure.text: The combustion chamber operates at pressures ranging from 0.25 to 0.5 atm.

variables.text: Fuels were diluted with molecular oxygen, atomic nitrogen, and helium to study the influence on flame extinction and dynamics.
variables.quote: Fuels diluted with molecular oxygen, atomic nitrogen, and helium to study the influence on flame extinction and dynamics.

measurements.text: Flames were observed with a black-and-white camera for droplet size measurements, a UV camera for capturing OH* radical emissions and flame size, and narrow-band and wide-band radiometers for analyzed flame radiation.
measurements.quote: Flames were observed with a black-and-white camera for droplet size measurements. A UV camera was used for capturing the OH* radical emissions and flame size. Other high resolution cameras were used for monitoring and documentation. Narrow-band and wide-band radiometers for analyzed flame radiation.

safety_finding.text: The research supports the design of safer spacecraft systems by refining knowledge of combustion in microgravity environments.
safety_finding.quote: support the design of safer spacecraft systems by refining knowledge of combustion in microgravity environments.

earth_benefits.text: Cool flames play a key role in the development and selection of new fuels and the design of advanced engines such as clean, high-efficiency Homogeneous Charge Compression Ignition (HCCI) engines.
earth_benefits.quote: Cool flames play a key role in the development and selection of new fuels and the design of advanced engines such as clean, high-efficiency Homogeneous Charge Compression Ignition (HCCI) engines.
